articles.title: Towards Decentralized Registries for Assets Metadata Information
articles.excerpt: Abstract:The effort to tokenize non-currency assets faces several hurdles, including the lack of a scalable decentralized computing infrastructure to manage asset-related metadata. While the centralized securities depository model has served the financial industry well for several decades, the vision of tokenization at a global scale requires new infrastructure that enables distributed control while protecting the integrity of asset-related metadata, regardless of where it is stored. articles.excerpt: Abstract:Bimanual manipulation policies require large and diverse training datasets, yet collecting demonstrations on physical robots is expensive and difficult to scale. articles.excerpt: Abstract:Lifelong navigation (LN) requires an embodied agent to solve a sequence of navigation subtasks in the same environment. Since solving each subtask from scratch incurs redundant exploration, an LN agent must consolidate experience from earlier stages and reuse it in later stages, often through persistent scene representations such as scene graphs or visual snapshots. articles.excerpt: Abstract:In multi-robot collaboration, task handovers rely on downstream verifiers performing remote attestation, which inspects sensor telemetry to ensure a robot's physical behavior strictly matches its assigned task. articles.title: mjorbit: A Simulation Framework for Space Robotics
articles.excerpt: Abstract:This paper presents a general framework for simulating multi-body space robots with contact. We bring efficient, large-scale robot simulation to in-space servicing, assembly, and manufacturing applications. articles.excerpt: Abstract:High-quality demonstration data is becoming a central bottleneck for training general-purpose humanoid robots. articles.excerpt: Abstract:Timed Partial Orders (TPOs), originally proposed for workflows, provide an interpretable framework for robot task specification with planning algorithms based on mixed-integer linear programming (MILP). articles.excerpt: Abstract:Learning-by-Demonstration (LbD) enables intuitive robot programming by capturing expert skills, which is crucial for agility in high-mix, low- volume manufacturing. articles.title: OcclusionCBF: Backup Control Barrier Functions for Safe Navigation Among Hidden Dynamic Obstacles
articles.excerpt: Abstract:Robots navigating under occlusion may enter states from which no admissible input can avoid a dynamic obstacle once it becomes visible. articles.excerpt: Abstract:We propose a unified strategy for fast goal inference in human-robot interaction.
